title: release-dsh-plugin

requirements.summary: Release only the DSH adapter artifact family to the npm registry.
acceptanceCriteria: Candidate preparation allocated the family-specific target version; promotion preserves it unchanged.
Focused adapter build, tests, and checks pass; the tarball contains lib/, skills/, cordis.patch.yml.
The exact vdsh-<version> tag points to clean origin/main.

@veewo/dsh-claw-kit@<npm-version> is publicly available; for a known authorized target profile, the exact published version is installed and its on-disk manifest/config verified without an unapproved restart.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the DSH release baseline
tasks.detail: Select the authorized tested frozen candidate and verify its artifact family, sourceRevision and trial; absent a candidate, use candidate preparation and stop before publication. Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, vdsh-* tags, package.json, and every worktree change. Resolve the CLI base version (authorized CLI candidate or current published @veewo/claw). Reject unapproved cross-family changes.

tasks.title: Confirm the frozen candidate version
tasks.detail: Read the chosen frozen candidate and its source manifests; verify the family-specific three/four-segment version, dependencies and npm mapping. Candidate preparation already allocated the number. Do not change versions, dependencies or lockfiles during promotion.

tasks.title: Verify built-in templated skill compatibility
tasks.detail: Review the candidate preparation evidence and, if needed, run the read-only npm run check:template-versions. Do not repair a selected frozen candidate in place; any required source/input repair needs a new candidate version and trial.

tasks.title: Verify the DSH plugin candidate
tasks.detail: Verify the frozen candidate inventory, hashes, exact sourceRevision, prior test evidence and seven-day trial. For DSH use npm run publish:dsh-plugin -- --candidate <directory> in verification-only mode; other families consume their recorded frozen tree through their artifact owner. Do not run workspace builds, package export or repacking. If evidence or content is wrong, prepare a new version rather than modifying this candidate.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source gate and release
tasks.detail: Require clean local main at the tested candidate sourceRevision and no remote divergence. Publish only the frozen DSH tgz using npm run publish:dsh-plugin -- --candidate <directory> --publish; verify exact registry retrieval. Only then complete authorized source push and immutable vdsh-<candidate-version> tag, requiring HEAD == origin/main and a clean worktree. Never rebuild the package or resend an accepted/unknown upload.

tasks.title: Verify the immutable DSH release
tasks.detail: Verify the exact npm version is publicly available and latest, the immutable vdsh-<version> tag matches clean origin/main, then install the exact published npm version into the known authorized DSH profile. A non-Electron profile takes `dsh plugin --profile <name> add @veewo/dsh-claw-kit@<npm-version>`; the Electron-managed desktop profile refuses that command and takes `plugin_manager(action: install_bundle, target: <exact spec or tarball>)` instead — never a direct profile file write. Then verify installed package.json, compatible CLI, the new bundle version, and (where the CLI accepts the profile) dump-config. Ask for the target if unknown; do not restart without separate explicit authorization. Runtime claw_run/skills verification remains deferred until the owner restarts.

references.why: Owns the DSH adapter release contract.

rules: Formal promotion requires the explicitly selected tested frozen candidate. Preserve its version and hashes; never bump, build, pack or export again. If no tested candidate exists, prepare a new version through beta:prepare and stop before publication.
Publish only @veewo/dsh-claw-kit to npm; never publish CLI/core or another adapter.
Never modify another artifact family without explicit batch authority.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.

Install the exact published package into a known authorized target profile; never restart a running DSH Host without separate explicit authorization or claim runtime activation from an on-disk install.

Write a profile only through its owner: the profile-scoped `dsh plugin` CLI for non-Electron profiles, and `plugin_manager` install_bundle (or the in-app Plugins page) for the Electron-managed desktop profile. Never write Electron-managed profile files with an Agent, filesystem tool, script, or shell.
